item.title: Windrose has one of the most popular Steam demos of recent times, helping the co-op pirate game rack up a million wishlists
item.description: A piratey survival game with a lot of promise, Windrose now has more Steam wishlists than Marathon as players lap up its new demo.

item.title: All Delta Force operators
item.description: The Delta Force operators each have unique strengths, and we have their skills, what's in their kit, and why you should be playing them.

item.title: Steam Next Fest has the perfect game demo for Disco Elysium fans, but it's not ZA/UM's successor
item.description: Steam Next Fest always offers up a plethora of exciting game demos, but 2026’s iteration looks to be a treat for fans of Disco Elysium.

item.title: GOG agrees with Ultrakill publisher boss that "the future of preservation is decided by players who give a s**t"
item.description: As it attempts to thrive in a world dominated by Steam, GOG calls on PC players to “prove together that preservation isn’t niche.”

item.title: Marathon targets another Arc Raiders weakness, boldly stating that cheaters will be "permabanned" with "no second chances"
item.description: Bungie reveals its anti-cheat plans for Marathon, including a zero-tolerance approach to bad actors that feels like a snipe at Arc Raiders.

item.title: With Steam Decks selling out and Game Pass' future uncertain, how will the next generation play games at all?
item.description: As Steam Decks sell out due to rocketing RAM prices and Xbox seemingly damns the Game Pass experiment, how will we play games in the future?

item.title: Final Fantasy 14 band The Primals will play at a huge rock festival, and I can't wait for a confused crowd to miss Temporal Stasis
item.description: Anyone who doesn't stop during FF14’s iconic Stasis Loop bop better get used to being whacked with a bunch of debuffs for their failures.

item.title: The Dune Spice Wars dev just put out a demo for its new online space crafting game, and yes, it has seamless planetary travel
item.description: After multiple strategy game hits, this team is bringing seamless space travel to SpaceCraft, an original online interplanetary trading sim.

item.title: Another Ubisoft shakeup will reunite some of the most experienced Assassin's Creed staff to oversee the franchise
item.description: That Black Flag remake might be deep at the bottom of the ocean, but the producer of the original release is now heading the AC franchise.

item.title: Despite appearing on MrBeast, this Amazon-funded party game is closing down after only six months on Steam
item.description: King of Meat proclaimed itself to be "everyone's favorite party-platforming game" before it launched, but it struggled to stick the landing.
